Card Q&A.a: Your opponent loses 2 memory, which means you gain 2 memory. If you use this card to give “[On Deletion] Lose 2 memory” to an opponent’s Digimon, you gain 2 memory when that Digimon is deleted.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card’s effect to give “[On Deletion] Lose 2 memory.” to an opponent’s Digimon. What happens when that Digimon is deleted?

Effect: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains "[On Deletion] Lose 2 memory" until the end of their next turn.
